How the research works

Research never stops. Every launch that passes your numbers gets a RugCheck report, its own token metadata (description and links) and the X post or account it links to, all within a few seconds. Launches that are already busy but still younger than your minimum age are researched early, so they alert the moment they're old enough.

The narrative score runs from 0 to 100: a real description (+20, short ones +10), its own X account (+15) and the X post it was made about (+15, or +20 with both; old or reused posts count less), a website (+8), Telegram (+5), a narrative match (+20 to +35), Grok seeing X posts about the token (+10), and a paid DexScreener profile or boost (+10). The strongest match is a narrative Grok found on X right now; after that come topics that the X posts of several new launches share, your own keywords, and tokens trending on Solana.

60+ reads as a strong narrative, 40 to 59 as some narrative. Only launches at or above your minimum (default 50) that also pass RugCheck alert. A narrative match can also mean a copycat of a coin that already ran, so open the X post before you act. Held launches are scored again on their own when new narratives arrive.

Data: GeckoTerminal (new pools, pool numbers, trending, chart candles), DexScreener (profiles, boosts, prices), Jupiter (the movers' top lists and stats), RugCheck (safety reports and the movers' rug scans), X's public embed service (linked posts), IPFS gateways (token metadata), Grok's X search (only with your xAI key) and a public Solana RPC (wallet activity, plus the movers' live prices and buy counts over its WebSocket). All requests only read data; your xAI key is sent only to api.x.ai. Keep one radar tab open: two tabs share the same free limits.

How movers are picked

Live prices: every token on the lists (up to 100) has its pool watched on-chain over your Solana RPC's WebSocket, so a trade moves its row within about a second (pump.fun curve, PumpSwap, Raydium, Orca and Meteora pools), and every number on screen is redrawn at least once a second. Rows marked live are streaming; the few pools the stream can't read get a fresh DexScreener price every second instead. Each list scrolls and shows up to 50 tokens; the order holds still while your pointer is on a list, and the numbers keep ticking. Click a row for its live chart.

Buy counts: B / S is buys and sells over the last 5 minutes. While a token streams, every buy the chain sees adds to it the moment it lands (exact per transaction on pump.fun and PumpSwap pools, one per pool change elsewhere), with the APIs' count covering the minutes before the radar started watching; buys/min is the last 60 seconds. Hover a count for its source.

Rising now: up at least 8% over the last 5 minutes (from the live price, Jupiter, GeckoTerminal or DexScreener), not down on the hour, more buys than sells, and enough trades and liquidity to trust the move. Ranked by the 5-minute gain, the last minute's move, buy pressure, volume pickup and the hourly trend.

Dip watch: ran at least 40% within the last hour, then pulled back 15 to 65% from the high with its liquidity still in place, and shows at least one bounce sign: back up 4%+ off the low, buys outnumbering sells over 5 minutes, or the last couple of minutes turning up. Tokens RugCheck or Jupiter flags are left out.

Rug check: every token on the lists (and the next 100 candidates below them) is checked from two sides, the chain first. From the chain, within a second or two: its mint and freeze authority and any Token-2022 trap (permanent delegate, transfer hook, frozen-by-default, pausable, a 5%+ fee), then its biggest holders with the bonding curve, pools and lockers left out, giving the biggest wallet and the top 10 wallets as a share of the supply (that catches bundled and insider-heavy launches). Until RugCheck answers, the row shows that verdict as CHAIN ✓ or CHAIN ✕. From RugCheck: its summary (score and risks) for every row, at a steady pace that eases off the moment RugCheck pushes back, and the full report (dev holding, insiders, LP lock) for the chart, launches, wallet trades and the top rows. Where both know, the live chain wins: a cached RugCheck report can still list an authority that was revoked since. Launches don't wait on a slow RugCheck: after a few seconds the chain check decides, and RugCheck's report updates the card when it lands; a verified launch that later fails (a whale piles in, RugCheck flags it) turns red and alerts you. Tag colours mean the same thing in every theme: RUG ✓ lit green passes cleanly (full report, very low score), RUG ✓ green passes, RUG ⚠ orange passes with a raised score or a heavy holder, RUG ✕ red fails your filters (the tags after it say why), RUGGED was pulled. Hover the badge for everything found, or open the chart for the full check. Failing tokens rank lower in Rising now and never show in Dip watch; "Hide risky" removes them.

The pool: Jupiter's top trending, traded and organic tokens, every launch the radar watches, Solana's trending pools of any age, verified launches and tokens your wallets trade. HELD means the radar held it back as a launch. Click any row for its live chart.

These are signs, not predictions: many dips keep dipping and many risers reverse, so check the chart and RugCheck first. Thresholds and the rug filter are in Filters; alerts and the live stream are in Settings.

    How it works

    Everything DA TR4D3RS runs in the background, what each part does, and whether it's working right now. It all starts on its own when the page opens; nothing here needs setting up.

    Checking…

    The pipeline

    Every new Solana launch goes through the same steps, nonstop, usually within a few seconds.

    1. 01

      Find

      PumpPortal announces every new pump.fun coin the second it's created; GeckoTerminal adds every other new Solana pool.

    2. 02

      Filter

      Each launch is checked against your numbers in the Filters tab. The ones that pass move on.

    3. 03

      Research

      Its description and links, the X post or account it links to, its website and Telegram, and matches with what's trending.

    4. 04

      Safety

      The chain is read first (mint, freeze, Token-2022 traps, biggest holders), then RugCheck. GoPlus fills in only while RugCheck can't answer.

    5. 05

      Score

      A 0–100 narrative score: 60+ is strong, 40–59 is some. Launches at or above your minimum (default 50) that pass safety go live.

    6. 06

      Alert

      A card lands in Verified launches, with sound, a desktop pop-up and a phone push through ntfy if you've turned those on.

    7. 07

      Trade

      Buy or sell from the card. Swaps route through Jupiter and your wallet asks you to approve each one. Or open it in fomo.

    Reading the safety tags

    Mint revoked

    Green: a check that passed.

    Mutable metadata

    Orange: worth knowing, not a blocker on its own.

    Freeze authority active

    Red: a real risk. Depending on your Filters, it holds the launch back.

    RugCheck 8/100GoPlus 0/100

    Risk scores, lower is safer: 0–20 good, 21–50 caution, over 50 risky. The GoPlus score is built from what it finds: an active mint or freeze authority adds 35 each, a danger risk 30, any other warning 12, mutable metadata 5.

    RUG ✓RUG ✓RUG ⚠RUG ✕

    On Movers rows: lit green passes cleanly, green passes, orange passes with a raised score or a heavy holder, red fails your filters. CHAIN means only the on-chain check has answered so far; GOPLUS means GoPlus scanned it.

    Alerts

    How you hear about launches, movers and wallet trades.

    Alerts on your phone, even with the app closed

    Phones pause apps you're not looking at, so the DA TR4D3RS on your computer does the watching and pushes each alert to the free ntfy app on your phone, with Chart, Buy and RugCheck buttons right on the notification. Leave it running: the Windows app keeps full speed even minimized; a browser tab or Chrome window should stay open (browsers slow down hidden tabs).

    1. Install ntfy from the App Store or Google Play.
    2. Make your private topic here and copy it.
    3. In ntfy tap +, paste the topic (server ntfy.sh) and subscribe.
    4. Paste the same topic into DA TR4D3RS on your computer (or bring it over with Settings > Backup), then press Send a test.

    The topic works like a password: anyone who knows it can read these alerts, so keep the long random one. Only computers send (a phone running the tool alerts on its own while it's open), at most one push every few seconds.

    Data sources

    How hard the radar works the free data sources, and where live prices come from.

    Scanning

    Optional. Without a key GeckoTerminal allows about 10 to 30 calls a minute depending on its load, so it pauses now and then. A free Demo key from CoinGecko reads the same data through api.coingecko.com at up to 100 calls a minute. The key stays in this browser and is only sent to api.coingecko.com.

    Live prices

    The live stream watches up to 100 tokens on the free public RPC (fewer if it pushes back); your own RPC (Helius, QuickNode and similar) can be faster.

    X & Grok

    Read the X posts launches link to, and let Grok scan all of X for narratives.

    X's own API doesn't work from a page opened like this, so the full X scan runs through Grok's X search with a key from console.x.ai. The key stays on this device and is only sent to api.x.ai. Each scan uses xAI credit (X search bills for every post it reads); the cost of the last scan shows above the feed.

    Trading

    Buy and sell from the launch cards and charts through your own Solana wallet. Swaps route through Jupiter; your wallet shows each one and asks you to approve it. DA TR4D3RS never sees your keys or seed phrase.

    Connect with the Connect wallet button at the top. Phantom, Solflare, Backpack and other Solana wallets that run in your browser work. Opened as a file in Chrome, a wallet extension needs "Allow access to file URLs" turned on (chrome://extensions, then the wallet's Details). In the desktop and phone apps, Buy opens Jupiter in your browser or wallet app instead.

    Fomo

    Connect your fomo account, import the traders you follow, and choose what the radar does with them. Their trades, alerts and a fomo search live in the FOMO hub on the Radar.

    Connect to fomo

    fomo's own API is private (it needs your fomo login and blocks other websites), so DA TR4D3RS never asks for your fomo password. Your handle links your fomo profile; your wallet (optional) is followed so your own trades show up too. Signed in (Settings › Account), the connection syncs to every device.

    Import your following

    1. Drag this button to your bookmarks bar (once). On a phone, use Copy bookmark code and save it as a bookmark. ⇪ fomo export
    2. On fomo.family, signed in, open your profile and click the bookmark. It reads your Following and Followers lists: each trader's @handle, name, picture and wallet.
    3. Press Copy in its panel, come back here and press Paste & import.

    The bookmark only reads the list fomo's own page shows you. It never touches your fomo login, and nothing leaves your browser except what you copy. You can also paste @handle wallet lines.

    Fomo holders

    fomo trades are recognized by fomo's trading wallet co-signing them (seen on fomo trades, not confirmed by fomo). Every fomo wallet the radar meets is remembered on this device, and on each coin their token account is read straight from the chain, so sold-out wallets drop off and partial sells count. The free public RPC can't list a coin's holders, so it reads a sample of trades plus the fomo wallets it knows. A holders RPC that supports holder lookups (a free Helius key works) reads every holder and checks each one for fomo trades. It's only used for this, so it won't eat into anything else.

    Smart-money alerts

    Clusters come from every fomo trade the radar reads: Live on fomo, the coins on your radar and the traders you follow. With "Scan the new tokens they buy" on, a cluster's coin goes straight into research too.

    Trends & news

    What people search, share and read right now. Every trend's words join the narratives, so coins named after them are searched first and score a narrative match.

    TikTok, Instagram and Facebook publish no public trending feed, so without Grok their tabs read the news about what's viral on each. Feeds come through rss2json.com (a free feed reader), Bluesky, Wikipedia and CoinGecko.

    Disclaimer

    DA TR4D3RS is a research tool, not financial advice. New Solana coins are extremely risky: most go to zero and many are rugs. Safety checks (RugCheck, GoPlus and the on-chain check) can miss things, and scores, "verified" labels, fomo holder counts and the analyst's match % are signals, not guarantees.

    Only trade what you can afford to lose and do your own research. Trades are signed in your own wallet; this app never sees your keys. Data comes from free public services that can be slow, wrong or down.

    What's new in v1.2 · Operation FOMO

    • Just added: a whole FOMO tab, instant fomo holders (every fomo app trade is heard the second it lands), import who you follow on fomo with their names and pictures, smoother live charts, and a new sign-in page.
    • FOMO hub: follow fomo traders (import your following), alerts for their buys with their new tokens scanned, live fomo trades, and a fomo search. Accounts with a master account, and Connect to fomo when you sign in.
    • Live fomo holders on every verified launch, and on the chart.
    • The big chart, rebuilt: TradingView's chart engine, from the coin's launch (including its pump.fun curve), with launch, alert, star and trade markers, candles, line or area, moving averages, 1h and 4h, and a side panel with picture, ATH, dev and fomo holders.
    • Cards minimize to one line, with cleaner sections. Pictures everywhere, and no picture, no verified launch. Held back is back, for 5 minutes each.
    • Finder gate: your min age filters coins at the finders, before the scanner. 5 new token finders, narrative-first search, and more live portals like PumpPortal: Bonk launches, graduations, your followed traders' trades the second they land, and Raydium LaunchLab, Meteora (Believe, Bags), Moonshot and boop.fun read straight off the chain.
    • GoPlus or RugCheck as your main safety scanner. Trends & news (Google, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, news, Wikipedia) feed the narratives. Dev search, and starring a coin saves its key info and watches its dev.
    • Basic UI: a still texture (grain, carbon, concrete, circuit and more) instead of moving effects. Plus 7 themes, 7 HUD styles, 7 effects, 22 fonts, panel settings (corners, borders, glow, blur, density) and the new DA/TT icon: white bubble letters, hacker-green drip words on black.
